source_scope: Synthetic public Tern fixture only. Templates must be frozen before cold trials; controller inserts them into Brain only after both cold trials.

memories.title: Tern stage locations
memories.content: aggregate_attempts is in tern/usage/ledger.py; allocate_slots is in tern/dispatch/allocator.py; render_report is in tern/reporting/summary.py. Their interfaces are in docs/contracts.md.

memories.title: Tern public checks
memories.content: From the Tern fixture root, run python tests/test_public.py, optionally with --role aggregation, --role allocation, or --role summary. The standard-library runner reads tests/public_cases.json.

memories.title: Tern ID and integer conventions
memories.content: Ingestion IDs use strip().casefold() and canonical Unicode sort order. The report validates canonical IDs without changing them. Booleans are invalid numeric counts, weights, revisions, and capacities.

memories.title: Earlier missing-measurement bug
memories.content: An earlier Tern fix used value is None to detect unknown measurements. Zero is measured data. A measured zero combined with an unknown contribution has known sum zero and one unknown contribution; truthiness loses this distinction.
